description: List the name of every public property data field, one per line. Does not bill per call. Pass filter to list only the names that contain a piece of text, for example score_, demographic_, assessment, permit or expand_listing. Follow with field_detail for each field's type, accepted filter values, aggregation support, expand set and price per value returned.

filter.description: Optional text to match inside field names, for example "score_", "demographic_", "assessment", "permit" or "expand_listing". Leave it out to list every field.

name: field_list
